versions.changelog:
Initial release of Alibaba Cloud Web Application Attacks Analysis.

- Supports analysis of Nginx, Apache, and IIS access logs (auto-detected), with accurate real client IP extraction.
- Detects 11 attack types, including CC attacks, proxy-pool bots, brute force, scanning/probes, abnormal crawlers, and surges in QPS, bandwidth, and status codes.
- Produces actionable security reports in ASCII text or Markdown, with separate Executive Summary and Structured Findings.
- Enforces strict user privacy: only analyzes files explicitly specified by the user, never scans or modifies files, and operates in a read-only mode.
- Uses a single entry script for all analysis and requires no third-party dependencies (Python 3 standard library only).
